g.text: The month-close sweep is a debit on the current account, so money out and end balance encode the saver flag directly. Quarantining those two

g.text: columns (34 → 32) is what separates the honest curve from the other two. Faint lines are the five individual folds; solid lines their vertical

g.text: average. Quoted AUCs are the mean of the five per-fold values ± 1 SD, the estimator validation_report.md pins.
